en: Color postcard showing a decorated stone fountain with animal-head spouts and rich ornamentation, standing in a flower bed on a busy urban square. In the background there are historic buildings, a domed former mosque and a mounted statue, with pedestrians and vintage cars suggesting a mid‑20th‑century scene. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with multilingual caption and publisher information.
